name: qa-kit
description: A spec-kit-style, step-gated QA process shell layered over qa-e2e-pilot: constitution → spec → scenarios → analyze → run. Each step produces a human-reviewable artifact and populates the engine's existing gate inputs; qa-e2e-pilot remains the verification engine. Defines a project QA constitution (roles + policy + a versioned hash) and per-spec role snapshots.
